chunks.text: Health insurance. Orbio offers two medical plans, a standard PPO and a high-deductible plan with an HSA. Coverage begins the first of the month after your start date. Orbio covers 80 percent of the employee premium and 50 percent for dependents.

Adding dependents. You can add a spouse, domestic partner, or child during open enrollment or within 30 days of a qualifying life event such as marriage or a birth. Add dependents in the Orbio app under Benefits, then upload proof such as a marriage or birth certificate.
Retirement and 401(k). Orbio matches 100 percent of the first 4 percent of salary you contribute to the 401(k). You are eligible after 90 days of employment. Matching contributions vest immediately.
Open enrollment. Open enrollment runs the first two weeks of November, with changes effective January 1. Outside that window you can only change benefits after a qualifying life event.
About Orbio. Orbio is an HR platform for frontline and shift-based workers. Employees here are spread across several sites and are supported by a central People team.

Office locations and hours. Orbio has offices in Austin, Denver, and a remote-first hub. Standard office hours are 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. local time, Monday through Friday. Shift workers follow the schedule in the Orbio app, not standard office hours.

Contacting HR. The HR line is staffed 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays. For anything outside those hours, leave a message in the Orbio app under Help, HR and someone responds within one business day. Urgent safety issues should go to your site manager first.
Holidays. Orbio observes 11 paid public holidays a year. The holiday calendar is in the Orbio app under Schedule, Holidays. Holidays that fall on a weekend are observed on the nearest weekday.

First day. On day one, arrive at your assigned location for 9 a.m. and check in with reception. Your manager will meet you for orientation. Remote hires get a video orientation link by email the evening before.

Required documents. Bring a government photo ID and your work-eligibility documents on your first day; in the US that means completing the I-9. Upload your bank details for direct deposit and your tax withholding form in the Orbio app within the first week.

Equipment and accounts. Your laptop and Orbio account are provisioned before you start. If your login isn't working on day one, contact IT, not HR. Your employee ID, in the format ORB followed by four digits, is on your welcome email and your app profile.

Probation period. New employees have a 90-day probation period. Benefits like the 401(k) match and some leave types begin only after probation ends. Your manager reviews progress at 30, 60, and 90 days.

Pay schedule. Orbio pays every two weeks, on alternate Fridays. If a payday falls on a public holiday, the deposit lands the business day before. Your first paycheck may cover a partial period depending on your start date.

Direct deposit. You set up direct deposit in the Orbio app under Profile, Pay, Bank details. Changes take one full pay cycle to take effect, so a mid-cycle change applies to the following paycheck, not the current one.

Pay discrepancies. If a paycheck looks wrong, the most common causes are unapproved overtime, a mid-cycle bank change, or a missed timesheet approval. HR can open a payroll correction; corrections are paid out on the next regular payday, not immediately.

Tax forms and payslips. Payslips are in the Orbio app under Pay, History. Your annual W-2 is posted by January 31 and emailed to your personal address on file. Replacement W-2s for prior years can be requested from HR.
PTO accrual. Full-time employees accrue 1.67 days of paid time off per month, which is 20 days a year. Accrual starts on your first day. Part-time employees accrue pro-rated to their scheduled hours.

Requesting time off. Submit time-off requests in the Orbio app under Schedule, Time off. Requests need manager approval and should go in at least two weeks ahead for planned leave. You can see your remaining balance on the same screen.

Sick leave. Sick days are separate from PTO. Full-time employees get 8 paid sick days a year. You do not need advance approval for sick leave, but you should notify your manager before your shift starts. A doctor's note is required after three consecutive sick days.

Carry-over and payout. You can carry over up to 5 unused PTO days into the next calendar year; anything above that is forfeited on December 31. Unused PTO is paid out at your final rate when you leave the company. Sick days are never paid out.
